svg.title: XRAG system architecture
svg.desc: Full document storage, asynchronous ingestion, retrieval and question answering architecture, including direct calls to parsing, embedding, vector database and chat services.

CLIENT
Upload documents · Search · Ask questions

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 380px; text-align: center; width: 380px;

span.p:
FASTAPI · :8000
Storage routes · Jobs route · Retrieval route · Q&A route

div.style: color: rgb(30, 58, 138) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 380px; text-align: center;

span.p:
S3StorageService
Upload / download · boto3
Updates manifest on artifact writes

div.style: color: rgb(30, 58, 138) !important; display: table; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 380px; text-align: center; width: 260px;

span.p:
RustFS · :9000
S3-compatible object storage
Persistent volume: rustfs_data

div.style: color: rgb(30, 58, 138) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 380px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Document artifacts
workspace_id / document_id /
raw · parsed.json · chunks.json · manifest.json

div.style: color: rgb(124, 45, 18) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 380px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Temporal server · :7233
Task queues · Workflow history · Retries
UI :8233 · Persistent volume: temporal_data

div.style: color: rgb(124, 45, 18) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 380px; text-align: center;

span.p:
IngestionWorkflow
Schedules activities in order
3-minute timeout per activity attempt

div.style: color: rgb(124, 45, 18) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 380px; text-align: center;

span.p:
1 · Parse activity
Read raw document
Parse into Markdown pages · Save parsed.json

div.style: color: rgb(124, 45, 18) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 380px; text-align: center;

span.p:
2 · Chunk activity
Read parsed.json · LlamaIndex
512 tokens / 50 overlap · Save chunks.json

div.style: color: rgb(124, 45, 18) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 380px; text-align: center;

span.p:
3 · Embed + index activity
Read chunks.json · Batches of 32
Embed text · Upsert vectors and payload

div.style: color: rgb(6, 78, 59) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 380px; text-align: center;

span.p:
1 · Embed query
Question / search text → query vector

div.style: color: rgb(6, 78, 59) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 380px; text-align: center;

span.p:
2 · Vector search
Query vector → cosine top-k search

div.style: color: rgb(6, 78, 59) !important; display: table; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 380px; text-align: center; width: 260px;

span.p:
3 · Retrieved snippets
Text · Similarity score · Metadata
Default top-k: 5

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 380px; text-align: center; width: 260px;
color: rgb(6, 78, 59) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 380px; text-align: center;

span.p:
QnAService
Question + retrieved text + instructions
Build grounded prompt

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 380px; text-align: center; width: 260px;
color: rgb(124, 45, 18) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 380px; text-align: center;

span.p:
LiteParse · :5707
HTTP POST /parse
Document bytes → Markdown pages
Caller: Parse activity

div.style: color: rgb(76, 29, 149) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 380px; text-align: center; width: 380px;

span.p:
Ollama · :11434
HTTP POST /api/embed
Text → numeric vectors · Model cache: ollama_data
Callers: Embed activity + RetrievalService

div.style: color: rgb(21, 94, 117) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 380px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Qdrant · :6333
Cosine similarity · Configured collection
Vectors + chunk text + source metadata
Persistent volume: qdrant_data

div.style: color: rgb(76, 29, 149) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 380px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Configured chat endpoint
Responses API · CHAT_MODEL_BASE_URL
Question + context → answer text
Caller: QnAService
